card_title: Artist Notes: Solid State Cologne: Vetiver Base
summary: Rugged portability. A wax-based, alcohol-free cologne that melts into the skin for a subtle, earthy, and highly localized scent profile.
description: Tactical olfactory application. Encased in heavy-gauge steel, this solid cologne utilizes a base of beeswax to bind the damp, woody notes of vetiver and cedar directly to the epidermis, ensuring a deeply personal sillage.
technical_overview: Offered at $45.0 for 15g, this KoColor COLOGNE is expertly formulated with Beeswax, Jojoba Oil, and Vetiver Essential Oil. It delivers a high-fidelity Earth Balm color profile (`#8B4513`) and leverages lipophilic scent entrapment.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Swipe a finger across the wax surface to generate heat, then massage directly into the pulse points.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Comb the residual wax on your fingers through the ends of your hair or beard for highly effective, long-lasting scent trapping.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Alcohol-free formulation ensures zero top-note burn-off, providing a linear, consistent scent from application to dry-down.
